profile.headline: making data useful
profile.summary:
My background spans the full data lifecycle: collection, processing, analysis, and sharing. I'm most interested in trip data like public transit, bike rides, and flights. I'm most at home writing queries in a data warehouse, with hands-on experience in Java, R, and SQL.

Currently, I'm focused on health care data, helping a non-profit health care payer make sense of large, multi-source datasets to drive better outcomes for members.

Previously, I worked on a query language to improve access to software observability metrics. On the transportation side, I used commercial flight data to monitor and predict airline performance, partnered with transit agencies to evaluate service performance and share open data, and helped traffic agencies collect and use traffic data to inform control decisions.

company.name: Intelligent Transportation Lab, Portland State University

publications.title: Evaluation of the Performance of the Sydney Coordinated Adaptive Traffic System (SCATS) on Powell Boulevard in Portland, OR
